purpose: Define the process for collecting five required management approvals and converting PENDING MANAGEMENT DECISION to GO / CONDITIONAL GO / NO-GO

required_sign_off_roles.responsibility: Feature completeness, customer value, roadmap alignment
required_sign_off_roles.approval_question: Do you confirm that AI-RISA Premium Report Factory is feature-complete and ready for paid-pilot engagement with the customer?
Do you confirm that the technical baseline is stable, tested, and production-ready for pilot deployment?

required_sign_off_roles.responsibility: Deployment readiness, support capability, SLA feasibility
required_sign_off_roles.approval_question: Do you confirm that operations infrastructure, staffing, and support processes are ready to support the pilot customer?

required_sign_off_roles.responsibility: Data privacy, liability, contract terms, regulatory requirements
required_sign_off_roles.approval_question: Do you confirm that legal and compliance requirements are met and documentation is acceptable for pilot engagement?

required_sign_off_roles.responsibility: Business case viability, pilot ROI, customer fit
required_sign_off_roles.approval_question: Do you confirm that the business case is sound, customer is qualified, and budget is authorized for the pilot engagement?

go_criteria.description: All five roles must vote GO and all launch conditions confirmed

conditional_go_criteria.description: At least 4 roles approve with documented conditions
requirements: 4 or 5 roles vote CONDITIONAL GO or GO
Mitigation plan approved for each condition
conditional_go_criteria.outcome: Pilot launch authorized with conditions; weekly check-ins required; escalation path defined

no_go_criteria.description: Any single role votes NO-GO with blocking issue
no_go_criteria.outcome: Pilot launch postponed; development/resolution work defined; decision re-opened after remediation

workflow_timeline.activity: Distribute sign-off templates to all five roles
Roles review evidence and draft approvals

final_update_process.step_1: Consolidate all five sign-off templates; verify all fields complete; calculate final decision
final_update_process.step_2: Update docs/paid_pilot_phase1_management_decision_record_v1.md with signatures, dates, and final status
final_update_process.step_4: Commit and tag updated decision record with tag: paid-pilot-phase1-management-decision-record-signed-v1
final_update_process.step_5: Execute next actions (launch prep, condition tracking, or re-review based on decision)

next_actions_by_decision.GO: Proceed to launch preparation (deployment, customer onboarding, first report generation)
next_actions_by_decision.CONDITIONAL GO: Begin condition tracking; schedule weekly check-ins; escalate blockers to executive sponsor
next_actions_by_decision.NO-GO: Defer pilot; open Phase 2 planning or product refinement work

workflow_execution_checklist: All five roles receive sign-off request with evidence links
Sign-off templates completed and returned by all roles
No blocking issues identified (or mitigation plan approved)
Final decision consolidated (GO / CONDITIONAL GO / NO-GO)
Decision record updated with signatures and dates
Summary JSON updated with final statuses
Commit and tag created for signed decision record
Next action authorized (launch prep, condition tracking, or re-review)
